name: Lead Intelligence — Google Maps + Yelp Discovery

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "{{ $('Set Config').item.json.ANTHROPIC_MODEL }}",
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "system": "You are a B2B lead qualification analyst evaluating small US businesses for fit with AI booking and AI receptionist automation. Output ONLY valid JSON matching the requested schema. No prose, no markdown fences. If a signal is unclear, set its sub-score conservatively and add a note to 'uncertainties'. Do not invent facts not present in the input.",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Analyze this business profile and return qualification JSON.

BUSINESS PROFILE:
{{ JSON.stringify({
  business_name: $json.business_name,
  category: $json.category,
  city: $json.city,
  state: $json.state,
  rating: $json.rating,
  reviews_count: $json.reviews_count,
  website: $json.website,
  phone: $json.phone,
  email: $json.email,
  description: $json.description,
  categories_detected: $json.categories_detected,
  booking_tools_detected: $json.booking_tools_detected,
  booking_method_detected: $json.booking_method_detected,
  website_signals: $json.website_signals
}).replace(/"/g, '\"') }}

Return EXACTLY this JSON shape:
{
  "manual_communication_dependency": {"score": 0-10, "evidence": [strings]},
  "booking_friction": {"score": 0-10, "evidence": [strings]},
  "automation_gap_signals": [strings],
  "engagement_quality": {"score": 0-10, "evidence": [strings]},
  "activity_level": {"score": 0-10, "evidence": [strings]},
  "pain_points": [up to 3 short strings],
  "suggested_outreach_angle": "one specific sentence referencing this business",
  "uncertainties": [strings],
  "overall_fit_confidence": 0.0-1.0
}

Scoring guidance:
- booking_friction high (8-10) = no online booking, must call/DM, or no website at all
- booking_friction low (0-3) = has Calendly/Square/Booksy/Vagaro/etc already (already automated)
- manual_communication_dependency high = phone-only, no chatbot, no auto-replies
- activity_level uses rating + reviews_count as proxies for real customer flow
- if booking_tools_detected is non-empty, manual_dependency should drop accordingly
- if reviews_count < 5, mark activity uncertain"
    }
  ]
}
